groups.meta: 25 points per player to enter Merrow
conditions: Entry requirements are thresholds, not costs. A successful Kela kill costs each player a net 12 points; failing costs nothing.
Everyone in the squad needs 25 points, so a pub partner without points blocks the run.
Rathuum is first to 25 kills against Executioners, no companions or gear, with a random handicap each match.
bonuses: Past 15 points, one Vodyanoi win funds about two Kela kills.

conditions: Bring a punch-through or beam weapon (Ignis, Glaxion Vandal, Gaze, a glaive) for the spinning-target lights; lacking one is the usual stall.
The drop resolves at mission end, so finish the mission.
Kela is immune to Viral procs and can't be staggered.
bonuses: Saryn parts are the end-of-mission reward on the same kill, so every run progresses both.
Mesa or high-status weapons make the damage phases trivial.

disclosures.title: the fight
disclosures.body: Phase 1: stand on the lit floor pads, then shoot the green light on the spinning wall device. At a third of her health she retreats, calls Orbital Strikes every 15 seconds, and you shoot four devices whose lights come on one at a time in random order. Phase 3 repeats phase 2. Dodge orbital strikes by standing on the wall left of the exit door, either side of the big monitor. If the fight won't progress, abort; failing costs no points.

conditions: It ships with a single polarity despite the 3-Forma bill, and burns 1.67 ammo per shot at full spool.
bonuses: Operation: Plague Star pays built Forma, which covers the 3-Forma bill if the timing works.
